test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He fell unconscious due to a snake bite, so the doctor quickly gave him ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of this sentence, the doctor would need to give an antidote to counteract the snake venom.
 
• Hence,** "antidote"** is the most appropriate word.
 
• Therefore, the **correct sentence** should read:* "He fell unconscious due to a snake bite, so the doctor quickly gave him the antidote."*

Therefore, the** correct answer **is** - Option 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Options 1, 2 and 4 ("the antibiotic", "the antigen", and "the antiquary") are inappropriate. 
 
• An** "antibiotic"** is used to fight bacterial infections, an **"antigen"** is a substance that promotes the production of antibodies, and an **"antiquary"** is a person who collects or studies ancient artifacts, none of which are helpful in a situation involving a snakebite.
